purpose: Give every BABILong row a machine-checkable target-blindness record (C-08) by re-running the ASCENT write path through a blinded row view, and verify that the instrumentation changed no output.

instrumentation.mechanism: the writer, readout and prompt builder receive a TargetBlindRow view on which reading 'target' (or iterating the row) raises TargetAccessError until reveal(); reveal() is called only after the ASCENT prompt is rendered; each result row records the keys read before reveal, the number of blocked attempts, the reveal phase, and a three-link provenance check that every retained fact is the verbatim input substring at its recorded position, that every parsed field occurs in that sentence, and that the rendered state string is the raw sentence or the canonical template of the fact's own fields; the runner aborts on any violation
instrumentation.writer_module_unchanged: ascent/babilong_memory.py is byte-identical to the retained runs' version; the static test that it never names the target field still passes
instrumentation.computation_path: unchanged: identical prompts, decoding, scoring; only the object through which the row is read and the position of the parser-accuracy audit (now after prompt construction) differ

hardware.rerun: NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB, UUID GPU-5b892f6f-ac8e-8c99-71ed-7efad31c6765, same instance and environment (/venv/py3123: Python 3.12.3, torch 2.8.0+cu128, transformers 4.57.6, tokenizers 0.22.2, safetensors 0.8.0, sentencepiece 0.2.2, numpy 2.3.2) as Phase 2A run 2

comparison_rules.exactness_of_instrumentation: for the six control pairs (same GPU, same environment, instrumented vs uninstrumented), every scientific field, every prediction row and every stored float must be identical (ladder levels 1-4 all true, ignoring only the new target_blindness row field and the new top-level preflight block). Any difference means the instrumentation changed behaviour: stop, investigate, disclose; do not proceed to interpretation.
comparison_rules.cross_architecture_sensitivity: the 60 instrumented cells are also compared to their retained Blackwell references with experiments/compare_crossarch_reproduction.py; the result extends the Phase 2A sensitivity analysis to all ten panels of both studies and is reported with the same ladder; no exactness is expected or claimed there
comparison_rules.target_blindness_acceptance: every one of the 4,800 rows must record blocked_target_access_attempts=0, target_read_before_reveal=false, keys_read_before_reveal ⊆ {input, question, task, row_id}, and state_derived_from_input_only=true; a single failing row is reported as such
